findings.title: SQL built from string formatting
findings.message: The query is assembled with string formatting or concatenation, which allows SQL injection.
findings.suggestion: Use parameters: cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = %s", (user_id,))

findings.title: SQL built from string formatting
findings.message: The SQL string is built by interpolating values, which allows SQL injection when it is executed.
findings.suggestion: Keep placeholders in the SQL and pass values separately to execute().

findings.title: Blocking sleep in async code
findings.message: time.sleep blocks the whole event loop, stalling every other request.

findings.title: Blocking HTTP call in async code
findings.message: `requests` is synchronous and blocks the event loop inside an async function.
findings.suggestion: Use an async client such as httpx.AsyncClient or aiohttp.

findings.title: Exception silently swallowed
findings.message: The exception is caught and ignored, so failures will go unnoticed.
findings.suggestion: Log the error or re-raise it; don't `pass`.

findings.title: Database query inside a loop (N+1)
findings.message: A query runs once per iteration; with N rows this makes N round trips to the database.
findings.suggestion: Fetch everything in one query (e.g. `WHERE id IN (...)`, select_related / prefetch_related, or a JOIN).

findings.title: Hard-coded credential
findings.message: A password, token or API key appears to be assigned a literal value.
findings.suggestion: Read the value from an environment variable or secrets manager instead.

findings.title: Possible XSS sink
findings.message: Assigning unsanitised content to innerHTML / dangerouslySetInnerHTML allows cross-site scripting.
findings.suggestion: Use textContent, or sanitise with a library such as DOMPurify.

findings.title: Mutable default argument
findings.message: Default values are created once, so this list/dict is shared between calls.
findings.suggestion: Default to None and create the object inside: `items=None` then `items = items or []`.

findings.title: Weak hash for sensitive data
findings.message: MD5 and SHA-1 are broken for passwords, signatures and integrity checks.
findings.suggestion: Use bcrypt/argon2 for passwords, or SHA-256+ (hashlib.sha256) for integrity.

findings.title: HTTP request inside a loop
findings.message: Sequential network calls in a loop are slow; latency adds up per item.
findings.suggestion: Batch the requests, or run them concurrently (asyncio.gather / Promise.all).

findings.title: New code without tests
findings.message: This PR adds 3 public function(s) (search_orders, sync_orders, hash_card) but no test file covers them.
findings.suggestion: Add tests for `search_orders` covering the normal case, edge cases and errors.

findings.title: New code without tests
findings.message: This PR adds 2 public function(s) (loadReceipts, renderNote) but no test file covers them.
findings.suggestion: Add tests for `loadReceipts` covering the normal case, edge cases and errors.

findings.title: Loose equality
findings.message: `==` coerces types (e.g. `0 == ''` is true); use strict equality.
